description: Alaska DGGS Geoportal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alaska Department of Natural Resources, Division of Geological & Geophysical Surveys. Alaska's Division of Geological & Geophysical Surveys (DGGS) portal helps users discover and access a wide variety of geospatial web apps, data, and services across the state of Alaska. Datasets include elevation, geology, volcanology, and general GIS data. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Landslides. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
